paper.title: ABot-AgentOS: A General Robotic Agent OS with Lifelong Multi-modal Memory

evidence.section: Abstract; EmbodiedWorldBench benchmark definition and evaluation
evidence.figure_or_table: Benchmark overview and main evaluation tables
evidence.paraphrase: More than 200 executable tasks across 16 indoor, outdoor, and hybrid scenes test navigation, object search, dialogue, dynamic events, trace-grounded scoring, and later-split reuse of promoted runtime knowledge.

adjudication_notes: 2026-09-17 scope review: Embodied tasks evaluate an agent with memory through navigation, object search, dialogue and replanning in changing scenes. The task benchmark is broader than memory diagnosis; the paper's separate memory evaluation uses other datasets. The legacy scope_status field is not a Table 2 exclusion rule; see data/benchmark_scope_review.json.
